name: DOT_MODE_LIST_AFTER_CSV
description: .mode csv then .mode list — last mode wins, list separator restored
stdin:
.mode list
.headers off
.separator |
.nullvalue NULL
.mode csv
.mode list
SELECT 1,2;

name: DOT_MODE_CSV_AFTER_LIST
description: .mode list then .mode csv — last mode wins, csv format applies
stdin:
.mode list
.headers off
.separator |
.nullvalue NULL
.mode list
.mode csv
SELECT 1,2;

name: DOT_MODE_JSON_AFTER_LIST
description: .mode list then .mode json — last mode wins, json wraps result
stdin:
.mode list
.headers off
.separator |
.nullvalue NULL
.mode list
.mode json
SELECT 1 AS a;

name: DOT_MODE_COLUMN_AFTER_LIST
description: .mode column auto-enables headers when prior was list

name: DOT_MODE_MARKDOWN_RESET_SEPARATOR
description: .mode markdown resets separator regardless of prior .separator

name: DOT_HEADERS_ON_THEN_OFF
description: .headers on then .headers off — no header row emitted
stdin:
.headers on
.headers off
.mode list
SELECT 1 AS a;

name: DOT_HEADERS_ON_PERSISTS
description: .headers on persists across statements

name: DOT_SEPARATOR_PIPE
description: .separator '|' (explicit) after .mode list — pipe between cols

name: DOT_SEPARATOR_SEMI
description: .separator ';' after .mode list — semicolon between cols

name: DOT_SEPARATOR_TAB
description: .separator '\t' after .mode list — tab between cols

name: DOT_NULLVALUE_NULL
description: .nullvalue NULL renders SQL NULL as literal 'NULL'
stdin:
.mode list
.headers off
.separator |
.nullvalue NULL
.nullvalue NULL
SELECT NULL, 1;

name: DOT_NULLVALUE_EMPTY
description: .nullvalue '' (empty) renders SQL NULL as empty string
stdin:
.mode list
.headers off
.separator |
.nullvalue NULL
.nullvalue ''
SELECT NULL, 1;

name: DOT_NULLVALUE_ANGLE
description: .nullvalue '<null>' renders SQL NULL as literal '<null>'
stdin:
.mode list
.headers off
.separator |
.nullvalue NULL
.nullvalue '<null>'
SELECT NULL, 1;

name: DOT_SCHEMA_NO_ARG
description: .schema with no arg lists all user table CREATE statements
stdin:
.mode list
.headers off
.separator |
.nullvalue NULL
CREATE TABLE foo(x INTEGER);
CREATE TABLE bar(y TEXT);
.schema
expected_stdout:
CREATE TABLE foo(x INTEGER);
CREATE TABLE bar(y TEXT);

name: DOT_SCHEMA_SQLITE_MASTER
description: .schema sqlite_master shows the catalog's CREATE
stdin:
.mode list
.headers off
.separator |
.nullvalue NULL
.schema sqlite_master
expected_stdout:
CREATE TABLE sqlite_master (
  type text,
  name text,
  tbl_name text,
  rootpage integer,
  sql text
);

name: DOT_SCHEMA_INDENT
description: .schema --indent prettifies output (single-line schema unchanged)
stdin:
.mode list
.headers off
.separator |
.nullvalue NULL
CREATE TABLE foo(x INTEGER, y TEXT);
.schema --indent
expected_stdout: CREATE TABLE foo(x INTEGER, y TEXT);

name: DOT_SCHEMA_NOSYS
description: .schema --nosys omits sqlite_* internal objects
stdin:
.mode list
.headers off
.separator |
.nullvalue NULL
CREATE TABLE foo(x INTEGER);
.schema --nosys

name: DOT_TABLES_NO_ARG
description: .tables lists all user tables alphabetically

name: DOT_TABLES_PATTERN
description: .tables PATTERN filters by GLOB-like pattern

name: DOT_DATABASES_MAIN
description: .databases shows the main database with its file path
stdin:
.mode list
.headers off
.separator |
.nullvalue NULL
.databases

name: DOT_READ_FILE
description: .read FILE executes the SQL script from FILE
stdin:
.mode list
.headers off
.separator |
.nullvalue NULL
.read {{TMP}}/setup.sql
SELECT x FROM r;
files:
CREATE TABLE r(x);
INSERT INTO r VALUES (1);

name: DOT_CHANGES_ON
description: .changes on reports row counts after each statement
stdin:
.mode list
.headers off
.separator |
.nullvalue NULL
.changes on
CREATE TABLE t(x);
INSERT INTO t VALUES (1),(2),(3);

name: DOT_CHANGES_OFF
description: .changes off (default) suppresses row-count summaries
stdin:
.mode list
.headers off
.separator |
.nullvalue NULL
.changes on
.changes off
CREATE TABLE t(x);
INSERT INTO t VALUES (1),(2),(3);

name: DOT_LINT_FKEY_INDEXES
description: .lint fkey-indexes recommends an index for the unindexed FK
stdin:
.mode list
.headers off
.separator |
.nullvalue NULL

CREATE TABLE c(p_id INTEGER REFERENCES p(id));
.lint fkey-indexes
